episodes.title: Agony in the Garden | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 12 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.short: Agony in the Garden | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 12 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.description: In this week’s episode, we explore the First Sorrowful Mystery of the Holy Rosary: the Agony in the Garden. In the Garden of Gethsemane, Jesus faces the suffering and death that await him, yet freely embraces the will of the Father out of love for us. Fr. James Brent, O.P., reflects on the profound mystery of Christ’s voluntary Passion and the love and obedience that led him to the Cross. Discover how his prayer in the Garden teaches us to bring our own suffering before the Father with faith ...

episodes.title: The Eucharist | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 11 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.short: The Eucharist | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 11 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.description: In this week’s episode Fr. James Brent, O.P., explores the fifth Luminous Mystery of the Holy Rosary: the Institution of the Eucharist. Learn about the nature of Jesus' sacrifice, and how He is still present in the Mass through His body and blood. Discover the spiritual power of the Luminous Mysteries in Episode 11 of Into The Mysteries of the Rosary. Follow along with Fr. James Brent, O.P., and listen to Into the Mysteries of the Rosary wherever you get your podcasts.

episodes.title: The Transfiguration | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 10 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.short: The Transfiguration | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 10 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.description: In this week’s episode, we explore the fourth Luminous Mystery of the Holy Rosary: the Transfiguration. On Mount Tabor, Jesus reveals his divine glory, inviting the apostles into a deeper knowledge of who he truly is. Fr. James Brent, O.P., reflects on the rich layers of this mystery and how the Transfiguration reveals our own path of transformation in Christ. Listen to Episode 10 of Into the Mysteries of the Rosary with Fr. James Brent, O.P., wherever you get your podcasts.

episodes.title: A Bold Proclamation | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 9 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.short: A Bold Proclamation | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 9 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.description: In this week’s episode Fr. James Brent, O.P., explores the third Luminous Mystery of the Holy Rosary: the Proclamation of the Kingdom of God. Learn about the nature of the Kingdom Jesus preached, and how it will unite us with the Trinity. Discover the spiritual depth of the Luminous Mysteries in Episode 9 of Into The Mysteries of the Rosary. Follow along with Fr. James Brent, O.P., and listen to Into the Mysteries of the Rosary wherever you get your podcasts.

episodes.title: The Divine Wedding Guest | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 8 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.short: The Divine Wedding Guest | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 8 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.description: In this week’s episode Fr. James Brent, O.P., explores the second Luminous Mystery of the Holy Rosary: the Wedding at Cana. Learn about Mary’s command “Do whatever he tells you,” and meditate on the close relationship between her and her Son, Jesus Christ. Discover the spiritual depth of the Luminous Mysteries in Episode 8 of Into The Mysteries of the Rosary. Follow along with Fr. James Brent, O.P., and listen to Into the Mysteries of the Rosary wherever you get your podcasts.

episodes.title: You Are My Beloved | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 7 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.short: You Are My Beloved | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 7 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.description: This week we explore the first Luminous Mystery of the Holy Rosary: the Baptism of Jesus. Why did Jesus think it was necessary? And what was the meaning of God’s comment to his Son after the Baptism? Discover the answers, and much more, in Episode 7 of Into The Mysteries of the Rosary. Follow along with Fr. James Brent, O.P., and listen to Into the Mysteries of the Rosary wherever you get your podcasts.

episodes.title: A Mysterious Finding | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 6 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.short: A Mysterious Finding | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 6 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.description: Today we explore the fifth Joyful Mystery of the Holy Rosary: the Finding in the Temple. Jesus’s actions anticipate his later disappearance in the three days before his resurrection, and give us tantalizing hints about his true identity as the Son of God. Are we ready to ponder the mystery of Christ’s words? Follow along with Fr. James Brent, O.P., and listen to Into the Mysteries of the Rosary wherever you get your podcasts.

episodes.title: An Amazing Presentation | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 5 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.short: An Amazing Presentation | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 5 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.description: Today we explore the fifth Joyful Mystery of the Holy Rosary: the Presentation. Learn to appreciate Jesus’ role in God’s plan through his birth, and his participation in the law. Listen to the fifth episode of Into the Mysteries of the Rosary with Fr. James Brent, O.P., wherever you get your podcasts.

episodes.short: A Wondrous Birth | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 4 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.description: A baby wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a feeding trough. To Mary, it may have seemed like a makeshift crib. To God, it was a revelation prepared from all eternity. In this episode of Into the Mysteries of the Rosary, Fr. James Brent, O.P. reflects on the Third Joyful Mystery: the Nativity. The eternal Son of God is born of the Virgin Mary. episodes.short: A Prophetic Visitation | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 3 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.

episodes.short: A Happy Announcement | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 2 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.

episodes.title: The Divine Secret Revealed in The Rosary | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 1 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.short: The Divine Secret Revealed in The Rosary | Into the Mysteries of the Rosary Ep 1 | Fr. James Brent, O.P.
episodes.description: What if the Rosary isn't just a string of beads, but a string of mysteries that hold the entire Gospel? In this opening episode of Into the Mysteries of the Rosary, Fr. James Brent, O.P. invites you into the great secret St. Paul speaks of in his letters: the mystery "hidden for ages and generations" but now revealed in Jesus Christ. episodes.short: Into the Mysteries of the Rosary: A New Contemplata Series
episodes.description: Into the Mysteries of the Rosary is a Contemplata mini series led by Fr. James Brent, O.P., offering guided meditations on each mystery of the Rosary. Beginning May 14, 2026, new episodes arrive every other week, with regular Contemplata episodes on the weeks between. Rooted in the tradition of the Dominican Friars, this series helps you enter more deeply into the life of Christ through prayerful reflection on the Joyful, Sorrowful, Glorious, and Luminous Mysteries.
